business_problem: The world’s largest network of fine chocolates was struggling to manage the massive amount of data generated by its business.
solution_summary: Cacau Show built a Microsoft-based workflow around Power BI because The world’s largest network of fine chocolates was struggling to manage the massive amount of data generated by its business. Source information is captured from frontline systems, documents, transactions, images, or conversations and then processed with cloud services that classify, summarize, model, or route the data for downstream use. The resulting records are stored in shared business or analytical systems and surfaced through apps, dashboards, or case workflows so staff can move from manual review to faster action while still keeping a governed human-in-the-loop process. This turns scattered data into an operational workflow rather than a static report, making the same platform useful for both daily execution and future scaling, and With the help of Microsoft Power BI, Cacau Show unified its data and gained efficiency and ease distributing it between employees and franchisees.

With more than 2,200 units distributed throughout all states, the company is the largest fine chocolate network in the world, serving more than 60 million consumers.
To meet demand, the network hires approximately 1,500 employees in its industrial and administrative area, and more than 10,000 people across the franchise network.
In different parts of the Cacau Show office and plants, there are Power BI dashboards that display data such as: daily and monthly billing, number of sales, distribution information, and many others.
